messages:
Marcus (Acme Inc.): Hey support — our prod app started returning 5xx / gateway timeouts when calling the hosted inference endpoint ~2026-03-15T10:12 PDT. POST to https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate hangs ~30s then 502 or occasionally 504. Sample curl & headers below. Impacting multiple customers. Please escalate.

Priya (support): Sorry you're seeing this Marcus. Can you paste a redacted exact request body + any response headers (x-rw-trace, x-rw-upstream, x-rw-node) you saw? Which region and SDK version? Also are you using streaming?

Marcus (Acme Inc.): Region: us-west-2. SDK: js v1.4.3. Not using streaming for this particular flow. Repro curl (redacted):

```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"xlarge-v1","input":"hello"}'
```

Response: 502 Bad Gateway
Headers we captured: x-rw-trace: rwt-20260315-01, x-rw-upstream: rdw-gen-pool-07, x-rw-node: gen-07-az1
Happening across API keys and a handful of users.

Liam (infra-oncall): Looking at infra metrics now. We see a sharp spike in 5xx starting ~2026-03-15T17:10Z (UTC). Most are 502/504 from edge -> backend. Backend connection resets and backend worker timeouts. Can you share request size / token length distribution? Also paste any full response headers if you have them.

Marcus (Acme Inc.): Tokens small (<1k). I'll DM full logs (trace ids) to you. Headers I gave earlier are representative.

Jenna (eng-runtime): tagging eng-runtime. We're observing increased connection timeouts to model workers in xlarge-v1 pools. There was a canary deployed earlier today with a cache-eviction tweak — suspecting eviction storm causing worker blocking. Escalating to rollback.

Liam (infra-oncall): Rolling back the cache-eviction canary for rdw-gen-pool-07 now (started 2026-03-15T17:12Z). We'll drain the pool and route traffic to rdw-gen-pool-04. Estimated mitigation ~6-8 minutes. Recommend clients use retries/backoff and idempotency to avoid duplicate effects while routing changes happen. SDK default retry may be conservative; suggest bumping attempts to 3-4 for now.

Marcus (Acme Inc.): We can failover traffic to us-east-1 as a stopgap. Will do that if you confirm. Also concerned about billing — if retries happen are we double billed?

Deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Rollback started for release 2026-03-15/caching-evict-change by jenkins at 2026-03-15T17:12:22Z

Priya (support): If you provide an x-rw-idempotency-key header we can ensure idempotent behavior server-side for non-streaming generation calls. We'll note affected traces for billing review.

Marcus (Acme Inc.): We weren't sending idempotency keys on this endpoint. We'll add them going forward. Switching our traffic to us-east-1 now as extra precaution.

Jenna (eng-runtime): Root cause confirmed: regression in new cache eviction algorithm created a hotspot and eviction storm that caused workers to block on local disk IO which triggered upstream LB to return 502/504. Canary rollback in progress and a circuit-breaker to detect eviction storms is being added. Postmortem + customer-facing summary coming.

Liam (infra-oncall): Metrics show 5xx rate dropping starting 2026-03-15T17:18Z. rdw-gen-pool-07 drained and traffic is stable on rdw-gen-pool-04.

Marcus (Acme Inc.): Confirming from our side: errors have dropped and requests to us-west-2 are succeeding again. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Priya (support): We'll attach the timeline and the trace ids you DM'd to the support ticket and keep you posted when the customer-facing summary is ready. If you want the specific request ids included in the report, DM them to me. :thumbsup:

Jenna (eng-runtime): Next actions: (1) postmortem with root cause and mitigations within 24h, (2) deploy circuit-breaker/telemetry for eviction storms, (3) update SDK docs with recommended retry/backoff & idempotency header examples.

Marcus (Acme Inc.): Appreciate the fast response. Please also add a short note if there are any recommended failover patterns we should implement (region switching or model variant suggestions).

Priya (support): Will include failover guidance in the customer summary. Marking this thread resolved for now but will reopen if you see any regressions. :white_check_mark:
